items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: So O'Neil Spencer, the drummer, came and got me

ctx.x: No, he'd get me out of bed. I didn't tell you that story. I was living around 138th Street. They'd get me

out of bed and Willie the Lion Smith was playing at the Nest, just piano. So O'Neil Spencer, the drummer, came and got me... I just got up and said, O.K. I've never been afraid to play with no man. I wouldn't call myself showing off when I play. I just started to play. So we played 'Tiger Rag' in 7 keys. I kept him there till 8 o'clock in the morning.
